title: Shelf Measurements Are Incorrect!
text:
Shelf Measurements Are Incorrect!. The post lists the shelf dimensions as:

Measures 31.5 inches high by 12.125 inches wide by 11.625 inches deep.

I purchased 12" wide cubes to go with this. In actuality the shelves are 11 x 10 1/2 and will not work for my 12 cubes. I need the 12" cubes to store paperwork.

It is heavy and I will not bother to put it together. What a waste.

product_metadata.title: ClosetMaid 8985 Stackable 3-Shelf Organizer, Espresso
features: **PLEASE NOTE: When opening this box, please make sure to remove all pieces before discarding the box. The back panel is usually pressed against the side of the box.**
The three spacious shelves with enclosed back is great for your closet or in your office. Ideal for storing folded garments or books. The material of the back panel is cardboard.
Features two adjustable shelves. The openings in this organizer will NOT accomodate the Cubeicals Fabric Drawers.
Works great with other ClosetMaid Stackable Organizers.
Easy to assemble; Material: laminated wood, product is TSCA Title VI Compliant
description: Take control of your time and space with help from ClosetMaid! Ideal for storing folded garments or books. The 3 Shelf Organizer featuring three spacious shelves with enclosed back is great for your closet or in your office. The sturdy frame with an espresso finish allows for stacking multiple units or mix and matching configurations with the 31 Inch Vertical Organizer.
3-Shelf organizer. 12-Inch wide by 31-Inch high by 12-Inch deep.
